## Chinese Traders Hold Breath Ahead of Xi-Trump Meeting as Trade Policy Uncertainty Peaks

An Xi-Trump meeting is a high-stakes binary for export controls, tariffs, and China's semiconductor access — any outcome would cascade through AI supply chains (NVDA, AMAT, LRCX, ASML) and memory names (MU, Samsung, SK Hynix) with China revenue exposure, making it the week's most consequential macro event for the tech portfolio.

- Chinese market participants have moved to a collective wait-and-see posture ahead of an imminent Xi-Trump meeting.
- The meeting is framed as a key binary event for tariff and trade policy direction.
- Coverage centers on sentiment and pre-positioning, not any announced policy outcome.
- Directional read is elevated macro uncertainty across China-exposed technology and semiconductor names.
